title: Provision Claude desktop with MDM using Unity Gateway
body: Admins can use `ug configure --global` from their mobile device management (MDM) software to provision the Claude desktop app machine-wide with governed models, MCP servers, and skills, and users can import their claude.ai projects and chats. This is available on macOS only. [Learn more](/aws/en/ai-gateway/coding-agent-rollout#roll-out-claude-desktop-with-mdm).
